subject: Urgent: FastBank production impact after model update (latency & errors)
messages:
From: Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@fastbank.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; payments-ops@fastbank.com
Cc: security@fastbank.com
Date: 2025-11-12T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Spike in latency + 500 errors after model update

Marissa — we started seeing a sharp regression after the model push last night (your note said v2.1-quantized). Since ~01:30 UTC we are seeing: 
- Median response latency up ~3x (from ~180ms to ~570ms)
- 500-level error rate ~8% of requests (was <0.2%)
- Throughput dropped intermittently during peak (we're seeing backpressure in our worker pool)

This is impacting payment authorization flows. Attached are a few client-side traces and sample requests (client_traces_20251112.json). We need immediate mitigation — either rollback to the previous serving variant or an emergency fallback. Please advise ASAP and open a bridge.

—Jorge
Jorge Ramos
Head of Payments, FastBank

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@fastbank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-12T09:19:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 500 errors after model update

Jorge — thanks for flagging and sharing the traces. I’m escalating internally and standing up a bridge now. 

Immediate plan: 
- I’ve pinged SRE/Platform (Vivek) to validate whether we can do an immediate rollback to v2.0 (non-quantized baseline) or enable the v2.0 fallback routing.
- CSM (Evelyn) will coordinate updates and SLA credit conversation.
- I’ll keep you posted on the bridge details within the next 10 minutes.

Do you want us to proceed with an automatic rollback if engineering confirms it’s safe? If yes, we’ll initiate and communicate ETA.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0190

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-12T09:31:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Spike in latency + 500 errors after model update

Bridging notes / quick triage: I opened PD-6542 and kicked off an automated trace capture (see redwood_trace_20251112.txt attached). Early signals: the v2.1-quantized kernel path is triggering a kernel fallback on GFX-80 hosts which causes CPU spin and stalls in the async dispatcher. Impact looks like coefficient mismatch in kernel-selection logic when sequence length distribution deviates from calibration samples. 

What I can do now: 
- Initiate immediate routing switch to v2.0 variant for FastBank only (no global impact). Routing change is low-risk and should restore baseline within ~10–20 minutes.
- If routing switch fails, plan B is to ramp down concurrency for v2.1 and enable a circuit-breaker to reject heavy tails at 10% to preserve P95 latency.

Attachments: redwood_trace_20251112.txt, latency_graphs_20251112.png
Jira: https://jira.internal/ENG-1139 (investigating quantization profile mismatch)
PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-6542

I’m going to start the routing rollback now unless I hear otherwise.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@fastbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-12T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 500 errors after model update

Jorge — quick update from our side: the team is performing a targeted routing rollback to the previous serving variant (v2.0) for your account. Estimated completion 20 minutes. We sincerely apologize for the disruption — we know this impacts payment flows. Once rollback completes we will validate: latency, 5xx error rate, and throughput across your peak windows. 

If you need a dedicated bridge number I can spin one up; otherwise I’ll post progress here. On our side we’ll also start a credit assessment per the SLA and prepare a post-incident timeline.

—Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotha <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-12T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Executive visibility: FastBank outage impact and outreach

Team — Laura here. I want executive visibility on this one. Please prepare a succinct one-page summary for FastBank C-suite and the timeline for the rollback/mitigation. I will join the 2:00 PM bridge today. Suggested remediation and customer offer: one month of platform credit and a prioritized postmortem that includes remediation ETA for the quantization mismatch.

Action items for Marissa/Rishi: 
- Draft an executive note and timeline for FastBank leadership (2–3 bullet summary + current status + next steps).
- Coordinate a postmortem plan with SRE and Engineering and schedule a readout within 48 hours.

CC’ing Tessa to help with exec comms.

—Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@fastbank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-13T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 500 errors after model update — rollback complete

Jorge — rollback to v2.0 completed successfully at 10:37 PST yesterday. Post-rollback validation shows: 
- Median latency returned to ~175–190ms (baseline)
- 5xx error rate reduced to 0.15%
- Throughput restored to expected levels for your peak windows

We’ve attached the preliminary postmortem draft and the internal root-cause ticket: ENG-1139. Next steps: 
1) Full engineering postmortem and remediation plan (ETA: 48 hours).
2) Customer readout with FastBank leadership — Laura has offered to join; we should propose a 30–45 minute slot in the next 24 hours.
3) Offer one month of platform credit per SLA; Evelyn will follow up with details.

We deeply regret the disruption. Please let me know if you’d like the readout now or tomorrow morning and any additional stakeholders to include.

Thanks for your patience — and apologies to the FastBank ops and security teams.

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: fastbank_postmortem_draft.pdf (attachment)
